chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What do you think if a man entered into the state of Ihram after a non-obligatory prayer, would that suffice for him? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَحْرَمَ: Entered into the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj/Umrah)
key_terms.يُجْزِيهِ: Would it suffice/be valid for him

ai.seo_question: Can one enter Ihram after performing a voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the validity of entering the state of Ihram immediately following a voluntary (nafl) prayer, addressing a specific fiqh detail regarding the timing of the ritual consecration. This ruling underscores the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence, allowing pilgrims to combine spiritual preparation with ritual purity without requiring a distinct, separate intention or waiting period, thereby facilitating the ease of worship emphasized in the tradition.
